en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large military formation with soldiers standing in formation on a broad, tree-lined avenue. Several officers on horseback are at the front, while rows of soldiers line up behind them. The image gives a sense of early 20th-century or late 19th-century military organization. The printed text 'Wasa.' and 'Waasa.' appears at the bottom, and 'Gloeburg & Co., Wiborg, Wiburg.' is printed on the side.
